# Slim down fetcher hierarchy and lazy-init codecs

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

- Replaces `Fetcher` base class with standalone functions (`fetchRaw`, `fetchBlob`, `fetchAndDecode`) and a `FetchBuffer` type
- Replaces inheritance-based fetcher hierarchy with composition: `RefineFetcher` and `AuthorizeFetcher` compose a `WorkPackageFetcher` instead of extending it
- Removes `WorkPackageContext` — `RefineContext` and `AuthorizeContext` are standalone
- Lazy-initializes codecs in `AccumulateContext` and all fetcher classes (created only on first use)

## Binary size impact (release PVM blob)

| Example | main (21a7c1a) | HEAD (a12c10c) | This PR | Saved vs HEAD |
|---------|---------------:|---------------:|--------:|--------------:|
| fibonacci | 31.3K | 36.6K | 34.8K | **-1.8K** |
| ecalli-test | 96.8K | 101.5K | 100.0K | **-1.5K** |

Dead function elimination restored for fibonacci (27 functions eliminated, was 0 on HEAD).

## What was removed

- `Fetcher` class (replaced by standalone functions + `FetchBuffer`)
- `WorkPackageContext` class (codecs moved to fetcher classes)
- Eager codec construction in context constructors (replaced by lazy `| null` getters)
- 12 functions eliminated from release binaries (eager setters, codec `.create()` calls)

## Test plan

- [x] All SDK tests pass (79/79)
- [x] Fibonacci example tests pass (5/5)
- [x] Ecalli-test example tests pass (31/31)
- [x] Both examples build successfully with PVM compilation

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Refactor**
  * Simplified SDK exports and replaced a monolithic fetcher with lightweight fetch primitives and an explicit reusable buffer.
  * Network/data fetch components now use composition and explicit buffer management instead of inherited context objects.
  * Codec initialization moved to lazy getters to reduce upfront work and memory at startup.
* **Tests**
  * Updated tests to use the new codec construction and fetching approach.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR removes the class-based Fetcher and WorkPackageContext APIs and replaces them with a buffer-based fetch model: it adds FetchBuffer and standalone fetch functions (fetchRaw, fetchBlob, fetchAndDecode). Context classes (AccumulateContext, AuthorizeContext, RefineContext) and several fetchers (AccumulateFetcher, AuthorizeFetcher, RefineFetcher, WorkPackageFetcher) were refactored to stop inheriting from removed base types, adopt composition, and use lazy codec initialization. sdk/index.ts exports were updated to reflect these changes.

- PR 49: Modifies sdk/index.ts exports for the JAM fetcher surface; overlaps with this PR's export changes.

</details>
